rules.statement: An owner of immovable property is entitled to enjoy it without disturbance and without fear of unjustifiable interference from outsiders. If his enjoyment is disturbed by forcible ouster, the remedies of a rei vindicatio action or (in appropriate cases) of a possessory action are available to him; if it is seriously threatened, he may demand in quia timet proceedings a declaration of his rights so as to prevent in anticipation the apprehended invasion of his rights of ownership.
